title: OccSTeP: Benchmarking 4D Occupancy Spatio-Temporal Persistence
summary: OccSTeP benchmarks reactive and action-conditioned proactive 4D occupancy forecasting under temporal disturbances such as dropped frames, missing or noisy history, and erroneous semantic labels.

mechanisms.name: Occupancy spatio-temporal persistence stress test
mechanisms.description: Evaluate whether a recurrent 4D scene state remains useful when observation history is missing or corrupted and when future occupancy is conditioned on a proposed ego action.
mechanisms.limitations: Autonomous-driving occupancy IoU does not establish calibrated DTR collision risk, wearable sensing, identity persistence, Android runtime, BLV benefit, or safety. A higher occupancy score may still worsen event behavior.
